PART 2: NOMINAL GROSS COUNTY PRODUCT
The Gross County Product for the period 2020 to 2024 was estimated at current and constant prices,
with 2016 as the base year. This section provides the nominal GCP estimates and their contribution to
total Gross Value Added. Table 8 shows the GCP estimates at current prices for the period 2020-2024.
Nairobi City County’s economy was estimated at KSh 4,105.6 billion, followed by Kiambu County at
KSh 819.8 billion and Nakuru at KSh 771.8 billion. Isiolo and Samburu counties registered the lowest
GCP levels at KSh 46.2 and KSh 44.8 billion, respectively. The five largest county economies had GCP
exceeding KSh 500 billion, namely Nairobi, Kiambu, Nakuru, Mombasa and Meru. On the other hand,
ten counties recorded GCP lower than KSh 100 billion. Most of these counties were from the Arid
and Semi-Arid (ASAL) regions, for example, Mandera, Wajir, Tana River, and Lamu, among others.
